en.answer: When resolving this effect, even if you no longer control another "Yosenju" monster when the effect resolves, the effect is still applied normally.
en.question: If the effect of <<11473>> which targets 1 card the opponent controls and returns it to the hand is activated, but I no longer control another "Yosenju" monster when the effect resolves, is the effect still applied?

ja.answer: 効果処理時に、「<<11473>>」以外に、自分のモンスターゾーンに表側表示の「妖仙獣」と名のついたモンスターが存在しなくなっている場合でも、処理は通常通り適用され、対象のカードは持ち主の手札に戻ります。
